title: Labor Market Response Act
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.
summary:
Labor Market Response Act

This bill requires grant applications for the Health Profession Opportunity Grants (HPOG) program to include information on in-demand jobs or worker shortages, including a description of the availability of recent labor market information. (The HPOG program provides education and training to low-income individuals for in-demand occupations in the health care field.)
